thesis.core: The breakout lacks a matching earnings or cash-flow inflection. 2026H1 revenue and profit fell sharply, and the company explicitly disclosed that the recent share-price surge is seriously detached from fundamentals and that several market themes have not yet generated operating contribution.
thesis.variant_wedge: Hydropower earnings can normalize with better water conditions and longer-term renewable projects may add optionality, but the current market price capitalizes those possibilities far in advance of current earnings and project realization.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Use 2026E normalized EPS bear/base/bull RMB0.10/RMB0.18/RMB0.30, above/b around the recent annual earnings run-rate but without capitalizing unbuilt offshore-wind or unproven thematic businesses.

operating_and_financial_quality.judgment: Current earnings are cyclical and weak; there is no disclosed fundamental inflection commensurate with the price breakout.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: 2025 attributable profit was RMB58.9m and 2026H1 attributable profit RMB29.4m; scenarios allow hydrology recovery but exclude unbuilt/unproven thematic projects.

catalysts: Hydrology normalizes and generation materially exceeds the weak H1 base.
Operating renewable projects with contracted economics move from optionality to attributable cash flow.
A durable earnings upgrade occurs without relying on thematic market narratives.
kill_thesis: Water inflows remain weak or generation falls below normalized assumptions.
Renewable project rights fail to reach construction/operation or returns are diluted by capex and financing costs.
The share price continues to discount unproven themes without a matching audited earnings step-up.
Regulatory or market-power pricing changes reduce normalized utility returns.
